title: Canonical unit and composition comparisons for exact etale pullback
statement: Let $A$ be a commutative ring of universe $u+1$ and let the schemes have universe $u$ [def-pc-scheme]. Use ordinary unbounded derived categories $D(T_{\mathrm{et}},A)$ of constant-$A$ module sheaves [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories], exact inverse image [def-weil-pbc-inverse-image] [prop-weil-pbc-inverse-image-modules-exact], and let $A_T$ be the constant coefficient sheaf placed in degree zero [def-kun-constant-sheaf]. Write $T_f=D(f^*)$ for the functor induced by applying inverse image termwise. (1) For any morphism $e:U\to X$, define $u_e:T_e(A_X)\xrightarrow{\sim}A_U$ to be the inverse of the canonical comparison $Le^*\cong D(e^*)$, evaluated at $A_X$, followed by the canonical left-derived pullback-unit comparison $Le^*A_X\cong A_U$. (2) For any composable morphisms $f:X\to Y$ and $g:Y\to Z$, define $c_{f,g}:T_{g\circ f}\xrightarrow{\sim}T_fT_g$ by descending the canonical sheaf inverse-image composition comparison $(g\circ f)^*\cong f^*g^*$ termwise and following it by the exact-functor derived-composition comparison. These specify the actual canonical isomorphisms, without any finiteness, Noetherian, compactification or etaleness hypothesis on the morphisms.

def etaleSumPullbackUnitIso
    (A : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing A] {U X : Scheme.{u}} (e : U ⟶ X) :
    (upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) e).mapDerivedCategory.obj (constantComplex A X) ≅
      constantComplex A U
lean.note:
Definition-only ownership of unchanged existing constructions. etaleSumPullbackUnitIso is in Sheaf.AlgebraicGeometry.EtaleSumRightAdjointCoherence; unboundedEtaleUpperStarCompIso is in Sheaf.AlgebraicGeometry.UnboundedEtaleCompactSupportComparisons. The latter signature is: noncomputable def unboundedEtaleUpperStarCompIso
    (A : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing A]
    {X Y Z : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) (g : Y ⟶ Z) :
    (upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) (f ≫ g)).mapDerivedCategory ≅
      (upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) g).mapDerivedCategory ⋙
        (upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) f).mapDerivedCategory. No theorem of either owning module is used to construct these definitions; the first assembles the canonical exact/left-derived and unit comparisons, and the second descends upperStarComp then uses mapDerivedCategoryCompIso. The two modules remain unchanged.
